title: CrossGuard: Safeguarding MLLMs against Joint-Modal Implicit Malicious Attacks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical security and safety aspect of protecting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) from jailbreak attacks. While it evaluates safety against categories such as 'unethical behavior', these are treated as malicious content domains for security filtering rather than an exploration or benchmarking of religion, moral reasoning, or formal ethical frameworks.
